name: What are the typical phases in an urban outdoor luxury project?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical phases in an urban outdoor luxury project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typical phases for an urban outdoor luxury project often begin with a comprehensive design and master planning phase, followed by initial site preparation and foundational work (e.g., grading, drainage). Subsequent phases might include hardscaping (patios, walkways, retaining walls), utility installations (lighting, irrigation, outdoor kitchens), softscaping (planting, lawns), and finally, the addition of specialized features like water elements, fire pits, or custom structures. The exact sequence can be tailored to the specific project scope and client priorities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical phases include design, site prep, hardscaping, utility installation, softscaping, and adding specialized features. The order varies by project.
